You registered a schema in mooring during the 2.0 beta, so we wanted you to hear this first: mooring is at the Streams conference this week.

**Office hours for teams migrating registries**

If your team is moving an existing registry to mooring, or weighing whether to, book a slot. We will sit down with you, look at what you have today, and map out the migration.

**Bring your own schemas**

The most useful sessions are the ones where we work on your actual schemas. Bring them along and we will run them through the demo.

Slots are limited and the conference starts in two days.

**[Sign up for office hours](https://tessera-labs.example/mooring/streams-office-hours)**

See you at Streams,

The mooring team at Tessera Labs
